title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above and in front. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square. A gold disc labelled Goal marks the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a blue arrow on the board pointing to a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the gold goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes only the row or only the column. The goal is up and to the right, so every Up or Right move brings you one step closer.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
A move that would leave the board does not move the token and is not counted. The start and goal never change; Reset returns to the same start.
